makeBoard.description: A board and a column under it for each column given.

cases.note: the same invocation with the columns reordered: every record gets the id it got in create-and-link

makeBoard.description: A board and a column under it for each column given.

cases.note: a find that matches skips the guarded create, and the operation returns what it found

ensureTag.description: The tag with this slug, made when there is none.

cases.note: a find that matches nothing lets the guarded create run, and the operation returns what it made

ensureTag.description: The tag with this slug, made when there is none.

cases.note: a failed check fails the operation with its named error, and the record made before it does not land

guarded.description: Makes a note, checks, and makes another — so a failed check must take the first back.

cases.note: a write to a record created earlier in the same operation lands on it

writeTwice.description: Makes a note and retitles it in the same operation.

cases.note: a strict link to a record already linked fails as alreadyLinked and changes nothing

adopt.description: Puts a record under another, strictly: refused when it is there already.

cases.note: core.upsertSignal with no reaction yet makes one under the record, and answers with its id

upsertSignal.description: Give the invoker’s reaction of one type on a record, or change it: one per person per type, edited in place, any duplicates removed.

value.description: What the reaction says. Zero is a value like any other; withdrawing is withdrawSignal.

cases.note: core.respond removes the answer the invoker gave before, on this record only, and makes the new one

respond.description: Give the invoker’s own answer to a record — going, maybe, not going — replacing any answer they gave before; with no kind, withdraw it.

kind.description: A reflexive InvolvementType’s slug; absent withdraws the answer.

errors.notAnAnswer: That is not an answer anybody can give to this.

cases.note: core.setInvolvement finds the pair on this record by its to-one, leaves the same pair on another record, and writes the new one’s node as one id

setInvolvement.description: Put somebody on a record as one of the space’s kinds of involvement, or take them off. A kind that is somebody’s own answer is given only by them, and replaces their last.

on.description: The state wanted, so pressing twice cannot undo itself.

errors.unknownKind: That is not a kind of involvement this space has.
errors.notYours: Only the person it is about can give that answer.

core.respond.description: Give the invoker’s own answer to a record — going, maybe, not going — replacing any answer they gave before; with no kind, withdraw it.

kind.description: A reflexive InvolvementType’s slug; absent withdraws the answer.

errors.notAnAnswer: That is not an answer anybody can give to this.

cases.note: core.createPost as a reply: in its subject’s responses and thread, a child of nothing, its block under it

createPost.description: Write a composed document — a post, a message or a reply — with its blocks, in a collection or in response to a record, threaded under its subject.

root.description: The root’s own fields: kind, mode, and what it stores about its blocks (editorState, textContent), plus where a copy came from.

blocks.description: The blocks in document order, each { key, entity, fields, parent } — parent the planned id of the collection block it is in, absent at the top level.

container.description: The collection it is a child of.

thread.description: The subject of the thread it joins — respondsTo, or the first record above it that is not itself a response.

generatedBy.description: The ModelRun that wrote it, when a model did.

errors.twoPlaces: A post goes in a collection or answers a record, not both.

fields.$: generatedBy ? merge(root, { mentions: mentions ?? [], generatedBy: generatedBy }) : merge(root, { mentions: mentions ?? [] })

core.thread.description: Link a response from the subject of the thread it joins, so the whole discussion under a record is one read.

thread.description: The subject of the thread it joins — what it answers, or the first record above that is not itself a response.

cases.note: core.moveCard leaves one column, joins the other where it was dropped, and takes a bound column’s state

moveCard.description: Move a card from one column to another, in one transaction: it leaves the first, joins the second (where it was dropped, or at the end), and takes the second’s state when that column is bound to one.

ids.description: The joined column’s order with the card where it was dropped. Omit to append.

cases.note: core.removeBoardColumn hands the column’s cards to the board and deletes the column, never a card

removeBoardColumn.description: Take a column off a board — never the work in it: its cards move to the board’s own arrangement, so a made board keeps them.

cases.note: core.placeCard edits the placement a canvas draws, removes the duplicate it outranks, and answers with what it held

placeCard.description: Write where a card sits on a canvas, or how it looks there: the placement the canvas draws is edited, or one made where there is none, and duplicates beside it removed. Answers { from, to } — what the fields held before — for an undo.

nodeType.description: Its entity, for a placement made here.

fields.description: Placement fields — x and y, a size, a colour, a rank …

placement.description: The placement the canvas draws for the card, where it has one.

duplicates.description: Placements of the card the drawn one outranks, to remove.

create.description: Whether a card with no placement may be given one. False for a style, which needs a position.

errors.notPlaced: Drag this onto the canvas first — how a card looks is saved with where it sits.

cases.note: core.createTaskState refuses a name whose slug a retired state still holds, and writes nothing

createTaskState.description: Name a state this community’s work moves through, refused when the space already has one by that name.

semantic.description: What it counts as, one of ['open', 'active', 'blocked', 'done', 'cancelled']; open when not given.

errors.noSlug: That name needs a letter or a digit in it.
errors.slugTaken: This space already has one called that.
errors.notASemantic: That is not something a state can count as.

cases.note: core.markRead moves the oldest marker for a record to the invocation’s time and removes a doubled one

markRead.description: Say the invoker has read a record as of now: one marker per record, moved forward.

returns.$: merge({ id: count(rows) > 0 ? first(rows).id : made.id }, { nodeId: node, spaceUuid: space, lastReadAt: invokedAt })

cases.note: core.deleteRecords deletes records of two types named at run time, and leaves the rest

deleteRecords.description: Delete several records of any type, for everyone, as one act. Not undoable.

cases.note: core.moveUnder takes a record off one holder’s list and onto another’s, the relation named at run time

moveUnder.description: Move a record from one holder to another through a to-many relation the holders declare — off the old list and onto the new in one write, so nobody reads it on neither or on both.

to.description: The holder it joins; absent to take it off and put it nowhere.

cases.note: an expect find that reads the same at the end lets the operation land

expecting.description: Reads the notes, expecting them to stay as read, and makes a tag.

cases.note: a note committed by another writer after the expect find read fails the operation as expectChanged, and its tag does not land

expecting.description: Reads the notes, expecting them to stay as read, and makes a tag.

cases.note: a find walking two levels down a relation reaches the children and grandchildren, and stops there

walkTwoDeep.description: The titles of what is under a record, two levels down.

cases.note: a transitive find reaches everything under the record, however deep

walkAll.description: The titles of everything under a record, however deep.

cases.note: NOT over a comparison matches a record with no value for the field, as well as one with another value

otherTags.description: The tags whose slug is not garden, a tag with no slug among them.

cases.note: a write the policy refuses fails the operation as refused, and the note made before it does not land

noteThenTag.description: Makes a note and then a tag, which the policy lets only a curator make.

cases.note: a record the operation made is its invoker’s, so a policy letting only the author delete lets the operation delete it

makeAndDrop.description: Makes a note and deletes it, which only its author may.

cases.note: a record made inside a call takes its id from the call’s path, and its author is the invoker

noteThroughCall.description: A note made by calling the operation that makes one.

cases.note: a create whose when is false writes nothing, and the name it would have bound reads as no value

maybeNote.description: A note when asked for one, and whether it was made.

cases.note: create-and-link replayed onto a dataset holding its done column: the replay names the same id for that key, is refused as recordExists, and adds nothing

makeBoard.description: A board and a column under it for each column given.

cases.note: a create whose derived id a record of another entity already holds is refused as recordExists
a write to an access-control entity, chosen at run time, fails as static protectedEntity, and the note made before it does not land

writeChosen.description: Makes a note, then a record of the entity it is given, from a list naming a protected one.

cases.note: an ordered relation reads back in the order written, an unordered one compares as a set, and records list by id in code-point order

linkTwo.description: Links two records under a holder, in the order given, through an ordered and an unordered relation.

cases.note: a create keyed by identity derives its id from the entity and the slug, not the invocation

nameState.description: A task state, keyed by its slug.

cases.note: another invocation naming the same identity derives the same id as identity-id

nameState.description: A task state, keyed by its slug.

cases.note: a second create of the same identity is refused as recordExists, and nothing the operation made lands

nameStateTwice.description: The same task state named twice in one operation, and a note before it.

cases.note: a record keyed by identity and one keyed by the invocation get different ids, the first the one identity-id derives

nameStateBesideNote.description: A task state keyed by its slug and a note keyed by the invocation, answering both ids.
